temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor at the mutual patient's funeral and hears Shirley say it has been tough and that she keeps wondering if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley cared for the patient but does not yet know how deeply affected or self-questioning Shirley is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed; she learns Shirley is grieving and second-guessing whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is deeply affected by the patient's death and is struggling to let go.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort Shirley, reassure her that they did everything they could, and support her through grief.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara senses Shirley feels burdened and hears Shirley explicitly say she feels responsible and wonders if a different treatment approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving, deeply affected, and possibly second-guessing the care decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara's belief is confirmed and sharpened: Shirley feels personally responsible for the outcome and is carrying a heavy burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley feels responsible for the patient's outcome and is struggling to accept that the decisions were reasonable.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility and help her see that the burden should not be carried alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley remaining reserved and minimally expressive, then confronts her quietly in the office. Shirley admits she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley feels responsible and burdened, and may be holding back her emotions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara learns that Shirley's guardedness is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak; this changes Sara's understanding of why Shirley has been reserved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley needs encouragement and a safe space to express emotions without fear of judgment.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to open up and reassure her that expressing emotion is healthy and acceptable among friends.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology; Shirley also says continued talking helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worries that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and possibly strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara learns that Shirley did find the confrontation somewhat intense, but she understands Sara's intentions and values the apology and continued support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship remains intact and that Shirley is receptive to gentle, ongoing support and conversation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To mend any strain, remain supportive in whatever way Shirley needs, and continue talking with her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved and hears Shirley say she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support. Shirley agrees to plan something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is still healing but is receptive to support and that their conversations have been helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara's hope is confirmed: Shirley is improving, credits their talks and support, and is willing to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is recovering, values their relationship, and is open to deepening their friendship outside of work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend more time together outside of work.
